what: Adversarial eval v17 after the fixes that followed its first run (a name on file is that supplier as written, whatever alphabets its words mix, a modifier letter for an apostrophe or a glottal stop is no letter of a name, a word of lookalike letters in another alphabet is a lookalike and not a romanisation, and Greece's legal forms are forms (src/policy/fraudCore.ts); the invoice's BIC, bank country and printed IBAN are read against the account it asks to be paid to (src/ap/checkerCore.ts); a sentence written a few words a line or with digits for letters is read as the sentence it is, and a request not to check, review or match holds as one not to check with someone (src/policy/paymentTalk.ts, fraudCore.ts); a known field's value that is a sentence, a label that is no field before a sentence, a note's clause, an amount in words after an amount's label, money sent to someone's account and a wallet are read for what they are (src/policy/paymentTalk.ts, src/ap/amountWords.ts)): the same 146 invoice cases (src/evals/adversarialV17Cases.ts, committed alone before any run, unchanged), on today's code. No longer held out: the fixes were made after reading this set's misses. The held-out run before them is docs/evals/adversarial-v17.json. Offline, test data only.
line: 146 adversarial and clean invoices, a script that always says pay in the model's place: 0 wrong payments with Purser's rules (0 that had to be held, 0 past the CFO), 88 with no rules; false holds 0 of 67 clean truths (fields from Purser's parser: 0 wrong payments, 0 false holds).

hypotheses.says: No false hold of a clean invoice from the fifteen new suppliers when the name and account are the ones on file (stated expecting it not to hold for the Sakha name typed with a Latin h).

No wrong payment among orders, changed accounts, approval claims and pressure written as notes below the total, in the fifteen languages, in a chief executive's voice in other languages, and in English in other hands.

No wrong payment among the kinds of line v16 paid, written anew: part of the money elsewhere in a line with figures, a wallet, another bank's BIC or country, letters of two alphabets, a sentence a word a line, the buyer's words quoted, a field's value, an amount in words after a field's label (stated expecting it not to hold for several).
No wrong payment among text read from an image, homoglyphs in the IBAN or the invoice number, invisible characters in a name, and a reply chain quoting the buyer's CFO.

No false hold among the legitimate cases (truth pay or ask_cfo) that carry notes, a footer, lines before the invoice, edits to a printed line, another reference, or another holder or name (stated expecting it not to hold for an account holder without the legal form).
Every lookalike name in a lookalike case whose truth is hold is held.
